detail.longDescription: Small-team tip: keep one "good example" file of your best past email, proposal or report. Paste it into the AI and say "match this style". Beats any long list of instructions. This week's issue covers the tools worth trying: https:// theearlyfinish.beehiiv.com/p/a i-tools-small-business-oct-23-2026 # AI # SmallBusiness # Productivity
